environment_note.java_difference: local OpenJDK 21 (nixos) vs remote 22.0.2; PTBTokenizer -preserveLines -lowerCase assumed version-stable; the parity gates against stored values verify this empirically
environment_note.remote_run_replaced: sbatch on Yonsei-DC1 not used for this stage because SSH was reset before banner for all agents (see artifacts/stage05-attempts.log); scoring ran locally, CPU only, single process

execution.scoring: rescoring of saved predictions only (no model loaded)

labels.note: All truncation rules are applied post hoc to saved eval-split Flickr predictions. Diagnostic only; no method/config/scorer is selected or changed, and no saved artifact is modified.

g4_independent_F.definition: kind=independent, task=F, stage=0 (8 seeds x 512 eval rows); no same-image old C exists (independent C is saved on the COCO eval split), so paired statistics are None for this cohort

flickr_last_cells.definition: 16 cells = orders {V_C_G_F, V_G_C_F} x 8 seeds; F = saved post-stage task-ID-oracle F-expert outputs; old C = saved pre-stage native outputs (expert C), paired per (order, seed, id)
flickr_last_cells.stored_corpus_source: oracle: routing_audit task_id_oracle matrix[3][3]; pre native: g4 results.json pre_task_scores[3]

truncation_rules.R1: cut at start of first repeated token trigram (tokens[pos:pos+3] == tokens[pos+3:pos+6], the exact repeated_trigram definition of sema_multimodal/model.py); keep text before the repeat; unchanged if none
truncation_rules.R2: cut at earliest ', and' or ' and a ' marker with >= 8 words before it; keep text before the marker start, rstripped; unchanged if none
truncation_rules.scope: applied ONLY to non-EOS outputs (generation.eos == true stays byte-identical); rules only delete text, never insert characters

truncated_variant_outputs.note: truncation rules only delete text, so a '.' can never be introduced; verified explicitly over every rule output

whole_input_file.note: every saved prediction row in artifacts/week1-per-example-scores.jsonl.gz (all kinds/stages/phases); archive-wide totals (incl. G1) are in artifacts/stage05-target-format.json
